title: SMC (k) for the Months of a Disability Compensation Temporary Total Rating
content:
The SMC (k) additions in a Disability Compensation temporary total past-due are one SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) grant, up to the SMC (k) maximum:

- for every temporary total month, when the latest grant's effective date is no later than the temporary total rating's own;
- for each of the whole months from that grant's effective date to the resumption's effective date, when it is later than the temporary total rating's effective date but earlier than the resumption's;
- nothing otherwise.

Each SMC (k) addition is 139.87 a month, and no more than 3 are counted. The SMC (k) grants are the rating decisions recording an SMC (k) grant; "the resumption" is the decision on the same claim recording that the prior rating resumed.

**Cases (hypothetical temporary total rating effective 10 February 2026, resumption effective 10 May 2026, 3 temporary total months, 1 SMC (k) grant)**

| Latest SMC (k) grant effective | Months with SMC (k) | SMC (k) amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 December 2025 | 3 | 419.61 |
| 10 February 2026 (same day) | 3 | 419.61 |
| 20 March 2026 | 1 (whole months to 10 May 2026) | 139.87 |
| 10 May 2026 or later | 0 | Nothing |
| No grant on record | 0 | Nothing |
